title: Maximum Vertex Degree in Graph

monster.name: Hydra Sentinel
monster.title: Bearer of Boundless Tendrils
monster.defeatQuote: The maximum degree among all graph nodes computed!

description: Given an integer `n` (the number of vertices from 0 to n - 1) and a list of undirected `edges`, return the maximum vertex degree in the graph.
starterCode:
def maxDegree(n: int, edges: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def maxDegree(n: int, edges: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    if n == 0: return 0
    deg = [0] * n
    for u, v in edges:
        deg[u] += 1
        deg[v] += 1
    return max(deg) if deg else 0
